correctness.rationale: The indexed Rule-45 Boolean identity yields x_i=1 XOR y_{i+1} XOR y_{i+2}x_{i+2}; iterating around an odd cycle and using the terminal forced-alternation contradiction closes without division. Finite injectivity proves a global inverse for all outputs. Expanding its nested prefixes gives exactly n+1 squarefree monomials and degree (n+1)/2, while conditioning on independent uniform bits gives influence sequence 1,1/2,1/2,1/4,1/4,..., with all n variables essential. Independent exhaustive maps/influences checked every output of odd n=1,3,5,7,9, not used as the general proof.
residual_risks: No assertion on even-sized rings, inverse iterates, or cryptographic avalanche guarantees.
